cyclophosphamide.t: Patients with rheumatoid arthritis previously treated with alkylating agents (cyclophosphamide, chlorambucil, melphalan, or others) may have a prohibitive risk of malignancy if treated with Azathioprine Tablets.

allopurinol.t: Patients receiving Azathioprine Tablets and allopurinol concomitantly should have a dose reduction of Azathioprine Tablets, to approximately 1/3 to 1/4 the usual dose.
One of the pathways for inactivation of azathioprine is inhibited by XO inhibitors (allopurinol or febuxostat).

febuxostat.t: Concomitant use of Azathioprine Tablets with febuxostat is not recommended.
One of the pathways for inactivation of azathioprine is inhibited by XO inhibitors (allopurinol or febuxostat).

warfarin.t: Azathioprine Tablets may inhibit the anticoagulant effect of warfarin.

acei.t: The use of angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors to control hypertension in patients on azathioprine has been reported to induce anemia and severe leukopenia.

anticoag.t: Azathioprine Tablets may inhibit the anticoagulant effect of warfarin.
